title: Logo / operational photographs
slide_intent: Demonstrate how a mark remains visible on real imagery so recognition survives varied subjects.
strategic_value: A suitable logo variant can link DB’s infrastructure and employee imagery.
demonstration: The left photograph carries a large white mark over track detail; the right worker photograph uses a smaller red mark and white headline.
practical_value: Compare contrasting logo variants and scales in photographic layouts.

content_islands.name: Track image
content_islands.spec: Overlay the white DB mark on the infrastructure photograph at left.

content_islands.name: Worker communication
content_islands.spec: Place the red logo high and the white two-line headline lower on the employee image at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The paired photographs show white and red logo variants in different photographic contexts.
